questions.q: How do shifting market expectations for near-term monetary tightening impact domestic equities?
o: Higher rate probabilities reprice the short end of the curve, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations.
Central bank tightening guarantees that corporate profit margins will expand across all retail sectors.
Fixed-income investors abandon sovereign bonds entirely, redirecting 100% of capital into speculative equities.
Equities become completely immune to changes in the cost of capital as corporate earnings decouple from interest rates.
questions.e: Tightening expectations lift the short end of the yield curve, increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows and driving equity valuation compression. The wrong options invent decoupled equity markets or guaranteed margin expansions.
